item.tib: rig 'dzin khod spungs dran pa yab yum gyi gsang grub chog khrigs
item.coloph: rgyal 'phags bla ma'i bka' lung bzhin/ bru yi btsun pa rgyal ba g.yung drung gis/ kha 'thor yig phran 'dzoms pa bkod/ 'gal 'khrul nor ba ci mchis pa/ bla ma yi dam rgod lcam bon skyong rnams la bzod par gsol/ gsang ngo / u ya ag tham//
